'''Chaughaine''' was a material used in the manufacture of clothing, including [[Cape/Legends|capes]], [[Robe/Legends|robes]], and sweaters. Wealthy individuals such as Madam [[Rhoden]] and [[Jenna Zan Arbor]] owned clothing made from chaughaine.
